parole.significato: The unpleasant after-effects of the consumption of alcohol; a hangover.
parole.testo: From Norwegian kveis (“uneasiness after debauchery”) + -algia (pain, suffering) (from New Latin -algia, from Ancient Greek ἄλγος (álgos, “pain”)), coined as a medical term by Jeffrey G.
